title: Quadratic Features
description: Identify what each form of a quadratic tells you quickly.
learningObjective: Students identify vertex, roots, and y-intercept information from common quadratic forms.

feedback.defaultCorrect: Correct. You matched the form to the feature it reveals.
feedback.defaultIncorrect: Not yet. Look at the structure of the quadratic before doing extra work.
feedback.defaultEncouragement: Ask what the form shows immediately.

questions.prompt: Which feature is easiest to identify from this form?
hints: Vertex form is a(x - h)^2 + k.
questions.incorrectFeedback: This form shows the vertex directly.

questions.prompt: Which feature is easiest to identify from this form?
hints: Set each factor equal to zero.
questions.correctFeedback: Correct. The roots are x = -4 and x = 2.
questions.incorrectFeedback: Factored form shows the roots most directly.

questions.prompt: What does the constant term show immediately?

choices.label: The axis of symmetry is x = 8

hints: Only the constant remains when x = 0.
questions.incorrectFeedback: In standard form, the constant term is the y-intercept.
